description: Packages an already-chosen palette into a professional, visible, downloadable deliverable. Takes the final colours once they have been decided, verifies and packages that decision, and returns the palette image plus PNG, SVG, PDF, ASE, JSON and CSS. It does not search, select, replace or improve anything: the colours sent are the colours that come back, in the same order. Each final colour is sent with its name; a colour is marked source-backed only when it is a Colour Memory archive record, and anything unverified is presented as the caller's recommendation, which is the honest description of it.

brief.description: The customer's request, in their words.

status.description: Leave out unless you know. Source-backed is checked against the archive and downgraded if it does not hold.

source_anchors.description: Archive records that informed the palette but are not in it. Give the record's name so it can be verified.
